name: dsh-memory-manager

meta.title: 记忆管理
meta.description: 以功能域为骨架的全局长期记忆：十二个记忆工具、主动回忆钩子与只读面板。

description: Function-area long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH): twelve memory tools (read/search/capability/write/index/insight/fold/rename/check/usage/federation/skill), an injected system-prompt discipline, a pre-step recall hook, and a read-only Web panel. Process stays in the session; memory keeps distilled conclusions.

scripts.test: node harness-test.mjs && node api-test.mjs && node ui-test.mjs
